Software Engineering

Part-A (10 x 1 = 10 Marks
Stem of the Question
Explain about Software Myths?
Define CMMI?
What are the User Requirements?
Summarize requirement elicitation and analysis?
Illustrate the Software architecture?
Construct a Collaboration diagram with your own example?
Justify the concept of White box testing?
List few metrics for software quality?
Determine few Software risks?
Explain risk projection and how it is used in risk management?

engineering.

OR

OR
